Transfer quest, unlocking travel from [[Elona]] to [[Cantha]], [[Nightfall]] to [[Factions]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
| transfer = factions
| unstarted = [[Mhenlo's Request]]
}}
You must also have completed and accepted the reward for [[The Time is Nigh]]

===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Funwa Shento]] in [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] to be directed to [[Mhenlo]].
* Speak to [[Mhenlo]] at the [[Consulate Docks]] to learn about what is occurring in [[Cantha]].
* Tell Mhenlo when you are ready to leave for Cantha.
* Find [[Dockhand Quangnai]] to learn more about the situation in Cantha.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Just follow the radar indicators. There will be no fights in this quest. Although this can be done solo, players may want to bring lower level heroes to make the most of the experience received.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Funwa Shento
:''"I've traveled here from Cantha with some bad news, I'm afraid. There are rumors of a plague spreading across our land. Sickness and death have infested Cantha, leaving the people terrified. I have come to find those willing to help us save our Empire. If you would help your neighbors in their time of need, please speak with Mhenlo. He can tell you more about the situation and arrange for your travel. Are you willing to help Cantha?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will speak with Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks.
| decline = I've got more pressing matters. Another time perhaps.
| ask = Speak to Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks to learn more about what is occurring in Cantha. 
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Mhenlo
:''"<Character name>! I'm glad Funwa found you. I have just received a dire letter from my old teacher in Cantha… Master Togo of Shing Jea Monastery… perhaps you've heard of him. It seems a violent and horrific plague has spread like wildfire through the streets and threatens to destroy all of Kaineng City.''
:''He has asked me to organize a group of skilled heroes and take them to Cantha where we can fight this evil at its source. I will be traveling to Kaineng City shortly. If you are up to the task, I would like you to come with me to help save the Dragon Empire from this horrible plague."''
: {{yes|ingame}} '''I wish to travel to Cantha.'''
:: ''If you have completed your business here in Elona and are ready to travel to Cantha, I have a ship prepared to carry us there immediately. Are you ready to travel to Cantha?''
:: {{yes|ingame}} '''Yes.''' (sent to [[Plague in Cantha (cinematic)]])
:: {{no|ingame}} '''No.'''
:;{{no}} I'll be on my way.

===Reward dialogue===
;Dockhand Quangnai
:''"Welcome to Cantha, <Character name>! We are in dire need of heroes. A terrible plague has spread across the city and threatens to engulf us all in chaos. It is indeed noble of you to come all this way to help our people."''

==Notes==
* This quest unlocks [[Kaineng City]] [[port]] (once you have arrived at [[Bejunkan Pier]]).
* Mutually exclusive with [[Mhenlo's Request]].
* A Nightfall character with this quest can [[ferry]] characters of any level (from any [[Campaign]]) to Cantha, provided that they have the [[Consulate Docks]] unlocked (i.e. by either having completed [[The Time is Nigh]] themselves, or having previously received a ferry to the docks from Kamadan via that quest).
** You can be taken to Benjunkan Pier by Mhenlo multiple times without restarting the quest and even after accepting the reward. There is no reason to keep this quest in your log.
** Ferried characters can map travel to Kaineng Center right away and do not have to walk there.
** In order to take the follow-up quest, [[Welcome to Cantha]], you must either accept the reward for this quest or abandon it. You can also skip Welcome to Cantha if you are ferried into [[Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter)]] by another character with that quest.
*See [[Campaign travel]] and [[Ferry]] for additional information.
